steps.name: verify-head-and-audit-risk-paths
steps.command: set -eu; echo '=== HEAD ==='; git rev-parse HEAD; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "61f9f29a028fc31f6e1640daf4cfa12fdc1badeb"; echo '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short --branch; echo '=== SCANNER/SERVICE RISK MARKERS ==='; git grep -n -E 'START_NOT_STICKY|START_STICKY|PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK|SCAN_MODE_LOW_LATENCY|startClassicDiscovery|DROP_OLDEST|resetSession\(|stopScanning\(|startScanning\(' -- app core feature || true; echo '=== ALERT RISK MARKERS ==='; git grep -n -E 'Ringtone|\.play\(\)|\.stop\(\)|vibrate\(|cancel\(|notify\(|setAutoCancel|cooldown|detectionEnabled|soundEnabled|vibrationEnabled' -- app core feature || true; echo '=== DEVICE IDENTITY/PERSISTENCE MARKERS ==='; git grep -n -E 'fingerprint|carryover|upsert|insert|updateScanData|getByFingerprint|lastSeenAt|encounterCount|deleteOldDevices|isProvisional' -- core/data/src/main/java | head -n 1200 || true; echo '=== TEST INVENTORY ==='; find core/data/src/test app/src/androidTest -type f -name '*Test.kt' -o -name '*Test.java' | sort | sed -n '1,500p'

steps.name: quality-gate
steps.command: export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/jdks/jdk-17.0.19+10/Contents/Home}"; ./gradlew qualityCheck --stacktrace; git diff --check; git status --short --branch
